title: Tenants
description: Tenants are the customers or organizations inside this product. Their data is strictly separated.

create.title: Create tenant
create.description: You can invite members after creating the tenant.
create.slugHelp: URL-friendly identifier, derived from the name. Must be unique within the product.

empty.title: No tenants yet
empty.body: Create a tenant for each customer or organization that uses this product.
empty.filteredBody: Try a different search or status filter.

detail.deleteBody: “{{name}}” and all of its data will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
detail.suspendBody: Members of “{{name}}” lose access until the tenant is reactivated. No data is deleted.
detail.suspendedNotice: This tenant is suspended. Its members cannot access it.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Invite people by email to join a tenant.
invitations.pickTenant: Choose a tenant to see its invitations
invitations.inviteDescription: The person receives an invitation to join this tenant.
invitations.oneTimeBody: Share this with the invited person now. It cannot be displayed again.
invitations.revokeBody: The invitation for {{email}} will stop working.
invitations.tokenHelp: The server has no public URL configured, so share the token. The person accepts it under “Accept invitation” after signing in.

accept.title: Accept invitation
accept.description: Join a tenant with the invitation token you received.
accept.successBody: You now have access. It may take a moment until it appears everywhere.
